name: Higanjima
source:
PSP visual novel based on the manga series Higanjima.
You play as main character Akira on the search for your missing brother. Along with your partners on the mysterious Higan Island, danger in form of blood-sucking vampires awaits you.
translation:
基于漫画系列《彼岸岛》的PSP视觉小说。
你扮演主角Akira寻找失踪的兄弟。与你的伙伴一起在神秘的彼岸岛，吸血吸血鬼的危险等待着你。
